services.name: Short Hop- Introduction Tour
services.desc: A brief introductory helicopter tour offering passengers the thrill and smooth experience of flight.

services.name: Scenic River Ride
services.desc: Description >Our River Ride takes you over the French Broad River and rolling hills of Sevier County. From 1,200 feet you will see the beautiful panorama of the Smoky Mountain countryside. The flight path covers approximately 8 miles and is guaranteed to have you ready for another helicopter adventure soon! ADDITIONAL POINTS OF INTEREST >• Smoky Mountain Knife Works >• Jet Boats >• Adrenaline Park >• Horseback Riding Rates > • $39 Per Person Flight Length > 8 miles

services.name: Lake View Tour
services.desc: Description >The Lake View Tour is a wonderful way to get your feet wet, so to speak, while experiencing a helicopter flight in the Smokies. Douglas Lake covers more than 28,000 acres across three counties and has over 500 miles of shoreline. This flight will carry you over the French Broad River toward Douglas Dam and up to the edge of Mountain Cove Marina. On clear days there are beautiful panoramic views of the Great Smoky Mountains in the distance. ADDITIONAL POINTS OF INTEREST >• Includes River Ride points of interest >• English Mountain >• Boat/Jet Ski Rental Areas >• Fishing/Camping >• Kyker Korn Maze (Seasonal) ![Description of

services.name: Introduction Tour
services.desc: Description >Get ready to check off a bucket list item! Experience the wonder of helicopter flight on this exciting 12-mile journey that takes off from Asheville Regional Airport. This First Flight experience will fly near Lake Julian offering distant panoramic views of what the area has to offer including The Smoky Mountains, Pisgah National Forest, and Downtown

services.name: Extended Lake Tour
services.desc: Description >The Extended Lake Tour includes and extends beyond the Lake View flight. Fly over Douglas Dam and proceed across Douglas Lake, nationally renowned for both largemouth bass and crappie fishing. >In the summer, you’ll see sun-glistening views of the water and people enjoying their time on the lake. During the winter, TVA lowers the water level generating electricity, so you’ll have majestic views of exposed islands and coves. >As your flight heads southwest, you will see the Great Smoky Mountains in the distance. On this flight, the helicopter climbs to a slightly higher altitude than on the Lake View flight, allowing for greater visibility of the national park. ADDITIONAL POINTS

services.name: Mountain Valley Tour
services.desc: Description >A very popular tour with groups wanting to see more of the area's natural beauty. It offers views of Sevierville, Pigeon Forge, and Bluff Mountain. As you take off on your flight out to Bluff Mountain and begin soaring over the Tennessee Valley, you are greeted with stunning views of the Great Smoky Mountains National Park in the distance. The highlight of this trip is getting up close and personal with Bluff Mountain and Sugarloaf Mountain. ADDITIONAL POINTS OF INTEREST >• Sevierville Courthouse >• Sevierville Golf Club >• Wilderness of the Smokies >• Bluff Mountain >• Sugarloaf Mountain >• Knoxville in the Distance ![Description of

services.name: Valentine's Day Celebration Flight
services.desc: Description >This VIP style private tour will take you on a romantic journey down the strip of Sevierville and Pigeon Forge. You will get to see iconic sites such as Dollywood, the Titanic, and The Island's famous 200 ft tall Ferris wheel, all while taking in breathtaking views of the Smoky Mountains in the distance. As you fly high above the beautiful landscape, you and your partner can enjoy spending quality time together and making unforgettable memories. And to make the experience even sweeter, upon your return, your date will be presented with a box of Valentine's chocolates, making it the perfect way to end your romantic adventure. So why not take your Valentine's Day to new heights

services.name: Sky River Rush
services.desc: Experience the thrill of this "Air to Water Combo" as Scenic Helicopter Tours partners with Smoky Mountain Jet Boat to bring you an extraordinary package that combines the beauty of the skies with the excitement of the water. Start your adventure with a private helicopter ride provided by Scenic Helicopter Tours, where you'll take off for a breathtaking 12-mile flight. Glide over the French Broad River, Douglas Lake, and the impressive Douglas Dam, all while enjoying the stunning views of East Tennessee's rolling hills and picturesque mountain landscapes from 1500 feet above ground. services.name: Smoky Mountain Spectacular
services.desc: Description >This deluxe tour is nothing short of spectacular! Offering awe-inspiring views of both the Tennessee and North Carolina sides of the Great Smoky National Park, this helicopter adventure covers almost the entire Tennessee side of the national park. services.name: Ridge Runner
services.desc: Description >Our Ridge Runner tour is an exciting flyover of the Chilhowee Mountain Range and Bluff Mountain. This scenic helicopter tour starts with a bird’s eye view of downtown Sevierville and the Tennessee Valley. As the flight progresses, you’ll travel over the foothills of the Smoky Mountains and the outskirts of Pigeon Forge and Waldens Creek with excellent views of the Smoky Mountain National Park. >Your journey continues as you round the back side of Bluff Mountain, featuring over 6,000 acres of undeveloped land. services.name: Pigeon Forge Night Flight
services.desc: Description >Experience sparkling panoramic views of Pigeon Forge from above. Soar over the Sevierville and Pigeon Forge skylines for a one-of-a-kind view of the area glowing in the evening darkness. As you peer down, your pilot guide will point out iconic sites such as The Island, Great Smoky Mountain Wheel, and Dollywood (seasonal) along the way. This is the perfect way to see Pigeon Forge at night! The lights of Winterfest shine November 7, 2024 through February 16, 2025. services.name: Asheville City Night Flight
services.desc: Description >Whether you are looking for a festive flight to kickoff your holiday season or a romantic getaway, our Asheville Night Flight has you covered . See historic historic Biltmore Estate all lit up from the air as you fly over Asheville on this scenic helicopter flight. This tour takes you north along Highway 26 towards Biltmore Forest and downtown Asheville. As you circle around Biltmore Forest you will see the Estate to your right and views of Asheville’s downtown "cityglow" on your left. Highlights include Biltmore House and Antler Hill Village and Downtown Asheville

services.name: Wears Valley Tour
services.desc: Description >Fly over one of Sevier County’s most beautiful areas - Wears Valley. This flight is dominated by spectacular mountain views from the very start! Upon departure you will travel over historic downtown Sevierville with the Smoky Mountain National Park in the distance. >After Sevierville, we continue over the rolling foothills of the Smoky Mountains and the Pigeon Forge Parkway before getting away from civilization over Pine Mountain. As you climb in altitude, you’ll follow the terrain up to the crest of Cove Mountain at the National Park boundary line where you’ll be met with spectacular views of the Wears Valley area.
